documents.library_help: Upload and share documents with client-side encryption. File contents and names remain private.
documents.search_documents: Search this page by name or ID
documents.no_received_documents: No received documents on this page
documents.empty_library_help: Upload a document, change your search, or move to the next page.
documents.page_scope_help: Search and counts apply to this page.
documents.locked_library_help: Unlock your vault to see filenames and open encrypted content.
documents.enrollment_help: Create a recovery key before storing documents. Only you and your chosen recipients hold decryption keys.
documents.unlock_help: Use your saved recovery key to unlock this vault locally. Your login password cannot recover encrypted documents.
documents.unlocked_help: Your decryption key is available in memory for this session. Lock the vault to clear it.
documents.unlock_to_continue: Unlock your vault to decrypt names, download files, or create shares.
documents.recovery_warning: Keep this key somewhere safe before continuing. Losing it means losing access to your encrypted documents.
documents.recovery_saved: I have saved my recovery key in a safe place.
documents.unlock_failed: Unable to unlock. Check the recovery key and the selected vault.
documents.recovery_private_help: The recovery key is used only in this browser and is never sent to the server.
documents.share_code_help: Give this code to someone who wants to share with you. Verify it through a trusted channel.
documents.reset_vault_help: Permanently remove your vault, all documents you own, and your incoming shares. Other owners’ documents remain. This cannot recover plaintext.
documents.reset_confirmation_help: The reset is bound to the user ID and key fingerprint shown above.
documents.upload_help: The browser encrypts the filename and every chunk before upload. Interrupted transfers retain exact encrypted bytes for an explicit retry on this page.
documents.filename_private_help: File contents, filename, and media type are encrypted before transmission.
documents.file_too_large: This file exceeds the vault or browser protocol size limit.
documents.upload_retry_help: Retry uses the same descriptor and encrypted bytes. Leaving this page discards local transfer state; unfinished uploads can be removed from the library.
documents.uncertain_allocation_help: The reservation may have completed. Review unfinished uploads in your library before starting another upload.
documents.discard_upload_help: Remove this unfinished upload and release its reserved storage.
documents.metadata_unavailable: Metadata could not be authenticated. Do not trust or download altered content.
documents.unfinished_upload_help: This upload has no complete encrypted metadata yet. Discard it if it cannot be resumed.
documents.download_failed_help: The download was not completed. Every chunk must authenticate before a file is offered.
documents.delete_document_help: Permanently remove this owned document and every recipient grant. Downloaded copies cannot be revoked.
documents.share_help: Use the recipient’s share code and verify its fingerprint before granting read access.
documents.recipient_code_help: Paste the recipient’s immutable user ID and fingerprint separated by a colon.
documents.fingerprint_confirmed: I verified this fingerprint with the recipient through a trusted channel.
documents.invalid_share_code: Enter a valid share code for a different account.
documents.share_retry_help: Retry keeps the exact encrypted grant. If the recipient key changed, start over with a verified new code; revoke an existing grant before replacing it.
documents.no_recipients: Only you have access to this document.
documents.revoke_help: Remove this recipient’s future access. Previously downloaded copies remain with the recipient.
documents.recipient_permissions_help: You received read access. Only the owner can delete this document or manage recipients.
global.copy_error: Copy failed. Select and copy the text manually.
global.error: Unable to complete this request. Check your connection and try again.
global.name: Name
global.access_denied: This operation is not permitted for this account or portal.
global.api_unavailable: This service or resource is unavailable. Check access and portal configuration.
global.quota_exceeded: The storage or resource quota has been reached.
global.conflict: The server state changed. Refresh and verify before trying again.
global.page_diagnostics_help: Inspect your browser environment and the connected server.
global.saved: Preferences are saved on this device.
global.token_payload_help: Explore the session claims returned by AuthCrunch. Expand objects and arrays to inspect their contents.
global.token_payload_note: Viewing claims does not verify a token signature.
global.token_payload_error: This payload cannot be displayed as a tree. You can still show or copy the original value.
global.token_method_other: An authentication method defined by the identity provider.
global.token_claim_amr: Authentication Methods References: the methods used to sign in. Several methods can appear together.
global.token_claim_acr: Authentication Context Class Reference: the assurance context assigned by the identity provider.
global.token_claim_iss: Issuer: the service that issued the token.
global.token_claim_sub: Subject: the identity this token represents.
global.token_claim_aud: Audience: the services this token is intended for.
global.token_claim_exp: Expiration time, in seconds since the Unix epoch.
global.token_claim_iat: Issued-at time, in seconds since the Unix epoch.
global.token_claim_nbf: Not-before time: the token is not valid before this Unix timestamp.
global.token_claim_auth_time: When authentication occurred, in seconds since the Unix epoch.
global.token_claim_jti: Token identifier: a unique identifier for this token.
global.token_claim_sid: Session identifier: the sign-in session associated with this token.
global.token_claim_roles: Effective roles carried by the session.
global.token_claim_authenticated: Authentication status reported by the portal.
global.token_claim_expires_at_utc: Expiration time formatted by the server in UTC.
global.token_claim_issued_at_utc: Issue time formatted by the server in UTC.
global.token_claim_not_before_utc: Not-before time formatted by the server in UTC.
global.token_method_otp: A one-time code, such as a code from an authenticator app.
global.token_method_hwk: Proof of possession of a hardware-protected key.
global.token_method_swk: Proof of possession of a software-protected key.
global.token_method_federated: Sign-in through an external identity provider.
global.token_method_user: A check that the user is physically present.
